brief.title: Scope the heuristic review
brief.plain_summary: Name the pages, the tasks people come to do, the personas, widths, themes and heuristics, and how many independent evaluators will review.
brief.outcome: A review scope every evaluator follows.

required: Group findings by the same-problem test: same page, heuristic and width, with regions overlapping by at least half of the smaller one.
Set each group's severity to the median rounded up and its spread to the range, and mark disagreement at a spread of 2 or more.
Keep look-alikes that fail the test separate and record why; never drop a finding seen by only one evaluator.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.

required: Choose one fix verb per confirmed finding: findings-to-fixes.propose-fix for a repair, taste-palettes.draft-embodiments for a choice with no single right answer, docs-improvement.draft-rewrite for wording in documentation, accessibility-audit.plan-audit when a WCAG criterion is involved.
Rank severity 4 findings first, then 3, then the rest, and say why each verb fits.
Return every fix as a proposed verb and propose findings-to-fixes.record-finding for each confirmed finding not yet recorded.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
